description: Public contact details published on a website: emails (including mailto links and [at] obfuscation, classified role or personal), phone numbers normalised to E.164, social profile links, address hints and Swedish organisation numbers for .se sites. Fetches the given page plus up to 3 contact-like pages (/contact, /kontakt, /about, /om-oss, /impressum) on the same host only. Honours robots.txt; returns 403 blocked_by_robots (not charged) if disallowed.
name: site_contacts
